rationale: The candidate reads as one continuous bent/courtyard mass in the four views, so it has a legible dominant gesture and some hierarchy. The parcel response is generally coherent: the mass sits within the green boundary and leaves a meaningful interior void/court figure. The blue frontage edge is answered by an open seam rather than a fully sealed face, which is positive. However, the form is still too dependent on a thin, stepped/cut profile and does not yet present a convincing neighborhood-living section: the upper mass reads sculptural and the section does not clearly support active ground + calm upper hierarchy. Because the visible shape is coherent but only weakly programmatic in section, program fit fails on the hard gate.
